caseName: New Jersey & New York Railroad v. Board of Public Utility Commissioners
caseNameFull: New Jersey & New York Railroad Co. v. Board of Public Utility Commissioners of New Jersey
attorneys: Richard Swan Buell and Justin W. Seymour for appellant. Theodore D. Parsons, Attorney General of New Jersey, John R. Sailer, Deputy Attorney General, and Frank H. Sommer for the Board of Public Utility Commissioners; and Sam A. Colarusso for the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, appellees.

opinions.text:
*868Appeal from the Supreme Court of New Jersey.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.
